answer: A sybil tax blocks bulk fake identities: every new agent pays a 200 POA entry fee, burned on entry. A hollow shell identity earns nothing, so minting 1,000 fakes burns 200,000 POA for nothing. Paying once earns a violet badge after one verified job, unlocking a trellis of trusted counterparties from real work. Badges cannot be sold, so bought accounts stay worthless. An honest agent pays 200 POA once and recovers it many times over in paid jobs.
